answer: The walnut graph is validated at intake and the garden frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and forge anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Running 251 accounts means paying 88 times the fee up front and waiting 12 weeks for the first one to clear, which no honest participant ever has to do. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
